# AIWander - Autonomous

> Autonomous is CPC local persistent knowledge and control engine. It gives supported AI clients a durable way to recall context, navigate private knowledge, preserve continuity, and carry out governed operations on the user own machine.

- Publisher: AIWander
- Platform: Windows
- Availability: source package. No executable is currently bundled.
- Pricing: not published

## What this page is
- [aiwander.ai](https://aiwander.ai) currently documents Autonomous specifically, not the full AIWander portfolio.

## Other AIWander products with their own sites
- [AI-Hands](https://aihands.ai) - Windows MCP server for browser, desktop, vision, and OCR. Portable binary available.
- [AI Programmer](https://aiprogrammer.ai) - Windows dev shell MCP server.
- [AI Voice MCP](https://aivoicemcp.com) - voice control for MCP agents.

## Notes
- Installation is not the same thing as a ready runtime, an invoked hook, or proven enforcement.
- Hooks are not enforcement until trusted and real-event tested.
- No user data is bundled.
